name: youmood-browser
description: youmood, a browser that matches your intentions.

scripts.sync: cp ../youmood-extension/rules.js ../youmood-extension/content.js ../youmood-extension/content.css ../youmood-extension/popup.html ../youmood-extension/popup.css ../youmood-extension/popup.js ext/ && cp ../youmood-extension/icons/icon128.png ext/icon.png && sed -i '' 's|runs youmood-bridge on 127.0.0.1:7331 using your Claude subscription|asks the claude CLI on this mac, on your Claude subscription|' ext/popup.html && node build-inject.mjs
